sloka: सर्वे भवन्तः सर्वेण हस्त्यश्वेन समावृताः।निर्यान्तु रथसङ्घैश्च पादातैश्चोपशोभिताः ।। ६.९४.३ ।।
transliteration: sarve bhavantaḥ sarveṇa hastyaśvena samāvṛtāḥ।niryāntu rathasaṅghaiśca pādātaiścopaśobhitāḥ ।। 6.94.3 ।।

translations.english: Let all of you, equipped with every elephant and horse, march forth resplendent with hosts of chariots and foot-soldiers.
